instruction: boltons.listutils.BarrelList (a list stored as several sublists) misbehaves at its bounds once it has more than one sublist: bl[len(bl)] returns an element instead of raising IndexError; insert() at an index at or past the end, or before the start, does not clamp to append or prepend the way list.insert does; and pop() can fail after the last sublist has been emptied. Make BarrelList behave exactly like a plain list for indexing, insert and pop at and beyond both ends, without leaving empty sublists behind. IndexedSet.difference_update() and intersection_update() must stay correct for large bulk removals and should not degrade to repeated per-item compaction. Add tests.
